title.en: Why Does an Agent Get Slower as It Runs?

dek.zh: 拆开 prefill、decode、KV cache 与 continuous batching，理解长 context 如何变成首 token 延迟、显存压力和每轮工具调用的重复账单。
dek.en: Separate prefill, decode, the KV cache, and continuous batching to see how long context becomes time to first token, memory pressure, and a repeated bill on every tool turn.

html.zh:
一次 LLM 调用不是均匀地“处理并输出 token”，而是两个性质不同的阶段。prefill 并行处理整个输入前缀，建立每层的 key/value（KV）状态；decode 随后一次生成一个 token，每一步只为新 token 计算新的 query、key、value，但用 query 读取所有可见的已缓存 key/value。两者分别主导 time to first token（TTFT）和 inter-token latency（ITL）。

KV cache 避免了把历史 token 反复送过所有 Transformer 层，却没有删除对历史的 attention。序列越长，每个 decode step 要读取的缓存越多，缓存本身占用的显存也越大。服务端还必须在很多长度不同、到达时间不同的请求之间调度 GPU。于是模型权重相同，Agent runtime 的 prompt 组装、tool output 大小、前缀可复用性与调度策略仍可让延迟和成本相差数倍。

核心判断：context window 是容量上限；KV cache 是避免重复计算的运行时状态；prompt caching 是跨请求复用部分 prefill 的服务能力。三者不是同一件事，也都不保证模型会正确利用上下文。
html.en:
An LLM call does not uniformly “process and emit tokens.” It has two computationally different phases. Prefill processes the complete input prefix in parallel and creates key/value state at every layer. Decode then generates one token at a time. Each step computes a new query, key, and value only for the newest token, while that query reads all visible cached keys and values. The two phases primarily shape time to first token (TTFT) and inter-token latency (ITL), respectively.

The KV cache prevents historical tokens from being pushed through every Transformer layer again, but it does not remove attention to history. As the sequence grows, each decode step reads more cached state, and that state itself consumes more accelerator memory. A serving system must also schedule requests that arrive at different times and have different lengths. Therefore two agent systems using identical model weights can differ dramatically in latency and cost because of prompt assembly, tool-result size, reusable-prefix structure, and server scheduling.

Core judgment: a context window is a capacity limit; a KV cache is per-sequence runtime state that avoids repeated computation; prompt caching is a serving feature that may reuse part of prefill across requests. They are not the same mechanism, and none guarantees that the model will use context correctly.

title.zh: 连接前两篇与 tool loop
title.en: Connect the first two parts to the tool loop

html.zh:
第 1 篇把模型的 token loop 与 Agent 的 action loop 分开：模型生成 tool call 的字符/token，runtime 才负责解析、授权和执行。第 2 篇打开一次 token prediction：embedding 和位置初始化 residual stream，attention 跨位置读取，MLP 做位置内计算，最后的 hidden state 被投影成 logits。今天把这张静态计算图放进时间轴。

设一次 Agent 轨迹先发送 system prompt、用户请求和工具定义。模型 prefill 这段前缀，decode 出一个 tool call；runtime 执行工具，把结果追加到消息历史，再发起下一次模型调用。若 API 是普通无状态请求，第二次调用通常重新提交完整历史：相同的 system prompt、用户消息、第一次 assistant tool call，以及新增 observation。即使应用只“追加一条消息”，服务端也必须重新获得对应的 KV 状态；没有命中可复用前缀时，它会再次 prefill 整段历史。
html.en:
Part 1 separated the model’s token loop from the agent’s action loop: the model emits tokens that represent a tool call, while the runtime parses, authorizes, and executes it. Part 2 opened one token prediction: embeddings and position initialize the residual stream, attention reads across positions, MLPs compute within a position, and the final hidden state is projected to logits. Today we place that static computation graph on a timeline.

Suppose an agent first sends its system prompt, user request, and tool definitions. The model prefills that prefix and decodes a tool call. The runtime executes the tool, appends the result to message history, and starts another model call. With an ordinary stateless API, the second request usually submits the complete history: the same system prompt, user message, first assistant tool call, and the new observation. Even if the application thinks it appended only one message, the server must obtain KV state for the entire corresponding sequence. Without a reusable-prefix hit, it prefills the whole history again.

title.zh: 机制：两阶段推理与调度

html.zh:
Prefill：并行但不是免费

对于长度为 S 的 prompt，所有位置已知，因此 GPU 可用矩阵乘法并行计算各层的 Q、K、V 和 MLP。标准 attention 在每层仍包含位置两两交互；FlashAttention 通过 tiling 与融合减少高带宽内存往返，精确计算同一 attention 结果，但并未把算术复杂度变成线性。prefill 往往吞吐较高，却随输入长度上升而增加 TTFT，并产生后续 decode 所需的 KV cache。

Decode：串行、memory-bandwidth sensitive

生成第一个输出 token 后，下一个 token 必须等待它，无法在同一序列内并行。每层仅为最新位置计算一组 Q/K/V，将新 K/V 追加进 cache，再让新 Q 与此前全部 K 做点积并对 V 加权。权重矩阵和 KV cache 在每一步被读取；对单请求而言，计算规模小到难以充分利用 GPU，且大量时间花在搬运权重和缓存，所以 batching 对吞吐极重要。

state = prefill(full_prefix)       # creates K,V for every layer and token
while not stop:
    logits, new_kv = decode(last_token, state.kv)
    token = sample(logits)
    state.kv.append(new_kv)        # history is reused, not forgotten
    yield token

MHA、MQA 与 GQA

传统 multi-head attention（MHA）让每个 query head 有自己的 K/V head，容量大但 cache 也大。Multi-Query Attention（MQA）让所有 query heads 共享一组 K/V，显著减少 decode 时缓存与内存带宽。Grouped-Query Attention（GQA）是折中：多个 query heads 共享一个 K/V head。GQA 论文报告，以少量 uptraining 可接近原 multi-head 模型质量，同时达到接近 MQA 的速度；这是论文在其模型与实验中的结果，不是任意模型的无条件保证。

Continuous batching 与 paged KV

静态 batching 等一批请求同时开始、以最慢序列结束，会产生 padding 和空闲槽。continuous batching 在每个迭代边界移出完成序列并插入新序列，让 GPU 始终有一组活跃 token。难点是每个序列的 cache 长度不同且增长。若为最大长度连续预留显存，会内部浪费；若反复分配连续块，会出现外部碎片。vLLM 的 PagedAttention 把 KV 切成固定大小 block，由 block table 把逻辑 token 位置映射到非连续物理块，并用 copy-on-write 支持共享。论文报告在其基准上显著提升吞吐；具体收益依硬件、模型、请求分布与实现而变。

调度仍有取舍：长 prefill 可能阻塞等待 decode 的交互请求；过小 chunk 降低 prefill 效率，过大 chunk 抬高 ITL。生产系统常用 chunked prefill、token budget、优先级或 admission control 协调 TTFT、ITL 与总吞吐，不能只优化 tokens/second 一个数字。
html.en:
Prefill: parallel, but not free

For a prompt of length S, all input positions are known, so the GPU can use large matrix operations to compute Q, K, V, and MLP outputs for many positions in parallel. Standard attention still contains pairwise interactions between positions in each layer. FlashAttention uses tiling and kernel fusion to reduce transfers to high-bandwidth memory and computes exact attention, but it does not turn the arithmetic complexity of dense attention into a linear operation. Prefill can achieve high throughput, yet longer input increases TTFT and creates the KV cache required by later decoding.

Decode: serial and sensitive to memory bandwidth

After the first output token, the next token depends on it, so steps within one sequence cannot run in parallel. Each layer computes one new set of Q, K, and V for the latest position, appends the new K and V to the cache, and compares the new Q with all prior keys before combining values. Model weights and cached state are read on every step. A single request often provides too little work to utilize a GPU efficiently, and moving weights and cache can dominate arithmetic. Batching multiple active sequences is therefore essential for serving throughput.

state = prefill(full_prefix)       # creates K,V for every layer and token
while not stop:
    logits, new_kv = decode(last_token, state.kv)
    token = sample(logits)
    state.kv.append(new_kv)        # history is reused, not forgotten
    yield token

MHA, MQA, and GQA

Classic multi-head attention (MHA) gives every query head its own key/value head. That provides capacity but creates a large cache. Multi-Query Attention (MQA) shares one K/V head across all query heads, sharply reducing cache size and memory traffic during decode. Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) is a compromise: each group of query heads shares one K/V head. The GQA paper reports that limited uptraining can produce quality close to the original multi-head model with speed comparable to MQA in its experiments. That is an empirical paper result, not an unconditional guarantee for every architecture or workload.

Continuous batching and paged KV storage

Static batching starts a group together and keeps the batch until its slowest sequence finishes, leaving padding and idle slots. Continuous batching removes completed sequences and inserts new ones at iteration boundaries, keeping a set of active tokens on the GPU. The difficult part is that every sequence has a different cache length and continues growing. Reserving a maximum-sized contiguous region wastes memory internally; repeatedly finding contiguous regions produces external fragmentation. vLLM’s PagedAttention divides KV state into fixed-size blocks. A block table maps logical token positions to non-contiguous physical blocks, and copy-on-write enables sharing. The paper reports large throughput gains on its benchmarks; realized gains depend on hardware, model, request distribution, and competing implementations.

Scheduling still involves policy. A large prefill can block interactive sequences waiting for a decode iteration. Tiny prefill chunks reduce that blocking but may lower prefill efficiency; large chunks improve bulk work while raising ITL. Production systems use mechanisms such as chunked prefill, iteration token budgets, priorities, and admission control to balance TTFT, ITL, and aggregate throughput. Optimizing a single tokens-per-second number is insufficient.

title.zh: 必要数学：cache 与重复工作
title.en: Essential math: cache size and repeated work

html.zh:
KV cache 显存

MKV = 2 × L × S × HKV × Dhead × B

L 是层数，S 是当前序列长度，HKV 是每层 K/V heads 数，Dhead 是 head dimension，B 是每元素字节数；系数 2 表示 key 和 value。batch 内各序列的 cache 相加，还要另算模型权重、activations、allocator 元数据和 workspace。例：32 层、8 个 KV heads、head dimension 128、FP16/BF16（2 bytes）的模型，每 token cache 为 2×32×8×128×2=131,072 bytes，约 128 KiB；32k token 约 4 GiB/sequence。若 MHA 有 32 个 KV heads，其 cache 约为四倍。量化 KV 可降低 B，但可能增加转换开销或精度风险。

attention 工作没有消失

在 decode 第 t 步，新 query 仍要与 S+t−1 个 key 比较。因此生成 T tokens 的单层 attention score 数量近似：

Cdecode-attn ∝ HQDhead[T·S + T(T−1)/2]

HQ 是 query heads 数。第一项说明长输入让每个输出 token 更贵；第二项说明输出自身也不断拉长 cache。KV cache 删掉的是历史 token 的 K/V projection、MLP 等重复前向计算，不是新 query 对历史的读取。

Agent 的重复 prefill 税

若第 r 次模型调用的输入长度为 Sr，没有跨请求缓存时总 prefill 工作粗略随 Σ f(Sr) 增长；dense attention 中 f 包含约二次 attention 项和约线性的投影/MLP 项。假设每轮追加 Δ token，Sr=S0+rΔ，旧前缀会在每轮再次参与 prefill。不能把 API 账单上的 input-token 单价直接等同 FLOPs，但工程方向明确：压缩 tool schema、限制 observation、稳定可缓存前缀、减少无价值 round trip，能同时改善 TTFT、显存可容纳并发数与费用。
html.en:
KV-cache memory

MKV = 2 × L × S × HKV × Dhead × B

L is the number of layers, S is current sequence length, HKV is the number of K/V heads per layer, Dhead is head dimension, and B is bytes per stored element. The factor of two represents both keys and values. Caches for all sequences in a batch are additive, and model weights, activations, allocator metadata, and temporary workspaces consume additional memory. Consider a 32-layer model with 8 KV heads, head dimension 128, and FP16 or BF16 cache elements of two bytes. Each token needs 2×32×8×128×2 = 131,072 bytes, or about 128 KiB. A 32k-token sequence therefore needs roughly 4 GiB. If MHA uses 32 KV heads, cache memory is approximately four times larger. KV quantization can reduce B, but may add conversion cost or accuracy risk.

Attention work has not disappeared

At decode step t, the new query must still compare with S+t−1 keys. The number of single-layer attention-score operations for T generated tokens is therefore approximately proportional to:

Cdecode-attn ∝ HQDhead[T·S + T(T−1)/2]

HQ is the number of query heads. The first term says long input makes every generated token more expensive. The second says generated output itself keeps extending the cache. KV caching removes repeated K/V projections, MLP evaluation, and other forward computation for historical tokens. It does not remove the newest query’s read over history.

The agent’s repeated-prefill tax

If model call r has input length Sr and there is no reuse across requests, total prefill work grows roughly with Σ f(Sr). For dense attention, f contains an approximately quadratic attention component plus roughly linear projection and MLP components. If each tool turn appends Δ tokens, then Sr = S0 + rΔ, and the old prefix participates in prefill again on every round. Provider input-token prices are not a direct FLOP meter, but the engineering direction is unambiguous: compact tool schemas, bounded observations, stable reusable prefixes, and fewer low-value round trips improve TTFT, memory-limited concurrency, and billed input together.

title.zh: 对 Agent 系统的影响

html.zh:
1. 优化轨迹，而不只是单次 prompt

一个 10k-token prompt 调一次与在五轮 tool loop 中反复携带它，不是同一成本。按 round 记录 input tokens、cached input tokens、TTFT、output tokens、ITL 与 tool wall time，才能区分模型 prefill、decode、队列等待和外部 I/O。只看端到端 p95 会把完全不同的瓶颈混在一起。

2. 把稳定内容放在前缀

服务端 prefix caching 通常要求 token 级精确匹配。稳定的 system prompt、工具定义与策略放在前面，动态时间戳、随机 ID、用户状态放后面，更容易复用。工具顺序变化、JSON 空白差异、模型版本或 tokenizer 改变都可能使缓存键失效。是否命中、保留多久、是否跨会话共享属于具体 provider 行为，必须查当前文档和 telemetry，不能从“支持 caching”推断。

3. observation 是计算预算

工具返回 2 MB JSON 后再让模型挑三项，等于把检索与过滤成本转成每个后续 round 的 prefill 和 cache。runtime 应用确定性 parser、投影、分页、top-k 或摘要生成高信号 observation，同时保存原始结果的引用和 provenance，必要时按需取回。摘要会丢信息，因此需要 schema、可追溯指针和针对任务的召回 eval。

4. cache 不是信任边界

复用缓存的安全性取决于 key 隔离和生命周期。跨 tenant 错配会造成严重数据泄露；在相同前缀后追加恶意 tool output，虽不改旧 KV，却仍会影响后续 hidden state；缓存被命中也不表示旧 policy 仍适用。权限、租户、模型版本、工具版本或 system policy 改变时应使复用域失效，由 runtime 重新授权每次副作用。

5. admission control 是产品设计

长 context 占住大量 KV blocks，可能让更多短请求排队或被驱逐。允许最大窗口，不等于所有请求都应使用最大窗口。按任务等级设置 input/output budget、并发上限、超时和降级路径，并在上下文压缩与重新 prefill 之间显式选择。否则一个“记住一切”的 Agent 会把整台服务变成低并发状态。
html.en:
1. Optimize the trajectory, not only one prompt

A 10k-token prompt used once is not equivalent to carrying it through five tool rounds. Record input tokens, cached input tokens, TTFT, output tokens, ITL, queue time, and tool wall time per round. Those measurements separate prefill, decode, scheduling, and external I/O. A single end-to-end p95 combines bottlenecks with completely different remedies.

2. Put stable material in the prefix

Server prefix caching commonly depends on exact token-level matches. Stable system instructions, tool definitions, and policy should precede dynamic timestamps, random identifiers, and user state. Tool reordering, JSON whitespace changes, a model revision, or a tokenizer change can invalidate a cache key. Cache eligibility, lifetime, reporting, and cross-session scope are provider-specific behaviors that require current documentation and telemetry. “Caching is supported” does not establish any of them.

3. An observation is a compute budget

Returning two megabytes of JSON and asking the model to select three fields shifts retrieval and filtering into every later prefill and cache allocation. A runtime should use deterministic parsing, projection, pagination, top-k retrieval, or summarization to produce a high-signal observation, while preserving references and provenance to the raw result for on-demand recovery. Summaries lose information, so they require schemas, traceable pointers, and task-specific recall evaluations.

4. A cache is not a trust boundary

Safe cache reuse depends on key isolation and lifecycle. A cross-tenant mismatch would be a severe disclosure. Appending malicious tool output after an unchanged prefix does not alter old KV entries, but it still changes later hidden states. A cache hit also does not prove an old policy remains applicable. Tenant, authorization, model version, tool version, and system-policy changes must invalidate the relevant reuse scope, while the runtime reauthorizes every side effect.

5. Admission control is product design

A long context occupies many KV blocks and can force more short requests to wait or be evicted. Supporting a maximum window does not mean every request should consume it. Set input and output budgets, concurrency limits, timeouts, and degradation paths by task class. Make an explicit choice between compressing context and paying to prefill it again. Otherwise an agent designed to “remember everything” can push the entire serving pool into a low-concurrency regime.

html.zh:
Prefix cache 命中率 vs prompt 灵活性：稳定前缀能省 prefill，但过度冻结 prompt 会妨碍个性化和策略更新。更危险的是把不同权限域的相似前缀错误共享。先定义 tenant/policy 隔离，再谈命中率。

长驻 KV vs 重算：保留 live session 的 cache 可快速续写，却占用稀缺显存；换出到 CPU/SSD 减少 GPU 压力但增加传输延迟；驱逐后重新 prefill 则消费计算。最优策略取决于会话再次活跃的概率，而不是单一窗口大小。

吞吐 vs 尾延迟：更大的 batch 通常提高 GPU 利用率，却增加排队时间；continuous batching 缓解空槽，不会消除 head-of-line blocking、长 prefill 干扰和抢占开销。SLO 应分别约束 TTFT 与 ITL，并按短交互/长批处理分池或设优先级。

压缩 vs 可恢复性：删掉旧 observation 降低成本，却可能删除后续决策所需证据。保留结构化事实、决策、未决项和原始 artifact 指针，比自然语言“总结整段对话”更可控。压缩器本身也会 hallucinate，必须测试 fidelity。

最常见误判：“已有 KV cache，所以多轮调用只算新增 token”。只有同一 live sequence 延续或服务端成功复用精确前缀时才接近成立。普通 API 客户端保存 message history，不等于客户端保存了模型所有层的 K/V tensors；账单与 telemetry 才是事实来源。
html.en:
Prefix-cache hit rate versus prompt flexibility: a stable prefix can save prefill, but over-freezing prompts can obstruct personalization and policy updates. More seriously, sharing similar prefixes across authorization domains can violate isolation. Define tenant and policy boundaries before optimizing hit rate.

Resident KV state versus recomputation: keeping a live session’s cache enables fast continuation but occupies scarce accelerator memory. Swapping state to CPU memory or storage reduces GPU pressure but adds transfer latency; eviction followed by prefill spends compute again. The optimal policy depends on the probability and timing of session reuse, not merely maximum window length.

Throughput versus tail latency: larger batches generally raise accelerator utilization while increasing queue time. Continuous batching reduces empty slots, but it does not eliminate head-of-line effects, interference from long prefill work, or preemption cost. SLOs should constrain TTFT and ITL separately, with separate pools or priorities for short interactive work and long bulk generation when needed.

Compression versus recoverability: deleting old observations reduces cost but may remove evidence required by a later decision. Preserving structured facts, decisions, unresolved items, and pointers to raw artifacts is more controllable than a natural-language summary of the whole conversation. A model-based compressor can itself hallucinate, so fidelity and retrieval after compression need evaluation.

The most common category error: “We have a KV cache, so later agent calls process only new tokens.” That is close to true only when a live sequence continues or a server successfully reuses an exact prefix. An API client retaining message history is not the same as retaining per-layer K/V tensors. Billing fields and serving telemetry, rather than the client abstraction, establish what was actually reused.

html.zh:
• prefill 并行处理完整输入并建立 KV；decode 串行生成，分别主要影响 TTFT 与 ITL。
  • KV cache 避免历史 token 重跑投影与 MLP，却仍随 sequence length 线性占显存，新 query 仍读取全部可见 key/value。
  • MQA/GQA 通过减少 KV heads 降低 cache 与带宽；paged allocation 解决可变长度序列的浪费和碎片，它们解决的是不同层次的问题。
  • 多轮 Agent 默认反复提交增长的历史；只有 live sequence 或精确 prefix cache 命中，才能避免对应的重复 prefill。
  • 工具输出长度、稳定前缀、调度策略和信任隔离共同决定经济性；应按每轮测 TTFT、ITL、queue、cached tokens 与 KV residency。
html.en:
• Prefill processes complete input in parallel and creates KV state; decode generates serially. They primarily shape TTFT and ITL, respectively.
  • The KV cache avoids rerunning projections and MLPs for historical tokens, but memory grows linearly with sequence length and each new query still reads all visible keys and values.
  • MQA and GQA reduce KV heads to lower cache and bandwidth; paged allocation reduces waste and fragmentation for variable-length sequences. They address different layers of the serving problem.
  • A multi-round agent normally resubmits growing history. Only continuation of a live sequence or an exact reusable-prefix hit avoids the corresponding repeated prefill.
  • Tool-result size, stable prefixes, scheduling policy, and trust isolation jointly determine economics. Measure TTFT, ITL, queue time, cached tokens, and KV residency per round.

html.zh:
• Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need — scaled dot-product 与 multi-head attention 的基础定义；原文是 encoder-decoder，并非现代 serving 系统说明书。
  • Shazeer, Fast Transformer Decoding: One Write-Head is All You Need — 提出 MQA，用共享 K/V 降低增量 decode 的内存带宽需求。
  • Ainslie et al., GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints — 提出 GQA 与 uptraining 配方；质量和速度表述来自论文实验边界。
  • Dao et al., FlashAttention — 用 IO-aware tiling 精确计算 attention、减少 HBM 访问；不是近似 attention，也不消除 dense attention 的全部长度成本。
  • Kwon et al., Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention — vLLM 的 block-based KV 管理、共享与 continuous batching 设计；吞吐提升是作者在指定系统基准上的报告。

本文关于 Agent prompt 结构、观测压缩、cache trust domain 与 per-round telemetry 的建议是基于这些机制的编辑性工程推论，不是上述论文直接验证的统一最佳实践。具体 provider 的 prefix caching、计费和保留策略会变化，应以使用时的官方文档与实测字段为准。
html.en:
• Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need — defines scaled dot-product and multi-head attention. The original architecture is encoder-decoder and is not a manual for modern serving systems.
  • Shazeer, Fast Transformer Decoding: One Write-Head is All You Need — introduces MQA to reduce memory-bandwidth requirements during incremental decoding by sharing K/V.
  • Ainslie et al., GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints — introduces GQA and an uptraining recipe. Quality and speed statements are bounded by the paper’s experiments.
  • Dao et al., FlashAttention — uses IO-aware tiling to compute exact attention with fewer HBM accesses. It is not approximate attention and does not remove every sequence-length cost of dense attention.
  • Kwon et al., Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention — describes vLLM’s block-based KV management, sharing, and serving design. Throughput improvements are author-reported results on specified system benchmarks.

The recommendations here about agent prompt structure, observation compression, cache trust domains, and per-round telemetry are editorial engineering deductions from these mechanisms, not universal best practices directly validated by those papers. Provider prefix-caching, billing, and retention behavior can change; current official documentation and observed response fields remain authoritative.

title.en: Closing the trilogy and choosing the next stop

html.zh:
LLM 内核 1/3：我们建立了两层状态机：自回归模型只在 token 分布上迭代，Agent runtime 才把结构化输出变成经授权的环境副作用。2/3：我们打开单次预测，看到 embedding、position、causal attention、MLP 与 residual stream 如何把前缀压进下一 token logits，并明确“在 context 中”不等于“可靠使用”。3/3：我们把计算图放进服务时间线，区分 prefill/decode，量化 KV cache，解释 batching、碎片和 tool loop 的重复 prefill 税。

本 series 已完成。现在你可以从一个 Agent trace 反推四类问题：模型为什么选择这个 token、runtime 为什么允许这个 action、这一轮为什么慢、增长的上下文为什么贵。仍未覆盖的是模型如何通过训练形成这些概率，以及 sampling、alignment 与推理策略如何改变行为。下一条系统主线将进入训练目标与推理控制：从 cross-entropy、teacher forcing、scaling 到 temperature/top-p 和 alignment，连接“学到了什么”与“运行时为何这样回答”。
html.en:
LLM Internals 1/3: we established two state machines. An autoregressive model iterates over token distributions; the agent runtime turns structured output into authorized environmental side effects. Part 2: we opened one prediction and followed embeddings, position, causal attention, MLPs, and the residual stream as they compress a prefix into next-token logits, while separating “inside context” from “reliably used.” Part 3: we placed that computation graph on a serving timeline, separated prefill from decode, quantified the KV cache, and explained batching, fragmentation, and the repeated-prefill tax of a tool loop.

This series is complete. You can now inspect an agent trace through four distinct questions: why the model selected a token, why the runtime permitted an action, why this round was slow, and why growing context was expensive. We have not yet explained how training creates those probabilities or how sampling, alignment, and inference policy change behavior. The next systematic curriculum area will be training objectives and inference control: cross-entropy, teacher forcing, scaling, temperature and top-p, and alignment—connecting what a model learned to why it answers as it does at runtime.
